decision_conditions: The existing hip to gable loft conversion and large rear dormer window to be retained by reason of its combined scale, bulk, mass is unduly prominent and detract from the character and appearance of the street scene and rear garden environment contrary to Policy 26 of the Local Plan 2021, the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2011), Policy D4 of the London Plan and also the guidance within the NPPF.

The rear dormer window is by reason of its height, position, bulk and rendered cheek appear out of scale and character with the dwelling and materially harmful to the visual amenity of the surrounding area contrary to Policy 26 of the Local Plan 2021, the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2011), Policy D4 of the London Plan and also the guidance within the NPPF.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mr Haque by e-mail on 03/07/26.
description: Hip to gable loft conversion with rear dormer and roof lights to front (Retrospective)
